title: SDG 10 平等 vs. 公平
footer: Teacher Dom · SDG #10 Equality vs. Equity 平等與公平

slides.eyebrow_en: A Bilingual Lesson for Grades 5 and 6

strip.zh: 項全球目標，這是第 10 項

strip.en: big words today: equal and fair
strip.zh: 個今天的關鍵字：平等與公平

lines.en: I grew up in Compton, California.
lines.zh: 我在美國加州的 Compton 長大。

lines.en: I have been teaching students in Taiwan for a couple of years.
lines.zh: 我在台灣教學生已經有幾年了。

lines.en: I won the UNA 2024 Young Leader of the Year Award.
lines.zh: 我獲得 2024 年聯合國協會青年領袖獎。

lines.en: Today: equal or fair — what is the difference?
lines.zh: 今天要談：平等和公平，差在哪裡？

slides.ask_en: Raise your hand: is “the same for everyone” always fair?
slides.ask_zh: 舉手：「每個人都一樣」，就一定公平嗎？

slides.ask_en: Your school has friends in California too — Windship Middle School in Eureka!
slides.ask_zh: 你們學校在加州也有朋友——尤里卡市的 Windship 中學！

slides.ask_en: Your lion dancer flew to California. Windship's pirate banana slug came to Yuanlin. Different, and still friends.
slides.ask_zh: 你們的小舞獅飛到了加州，Windship 的海盜香蕉蛞蝓來到員林。不一樣，還是好朋友。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have ever been the new person somewhere.
prompts.zh: 曾經是某個地方的新來的人，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have ever felt left out of a game.
prompts.zh: 曾經覺得自己被排除在遊戲外的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if someone once made you feel welcome.
prompts.zh: 曾經有人讓你覺得被歡迎的，站起來。

slides.punch_en: That one person changed everything. Today, you can be that person.
slides.punch_zh: 那一個人改變了一切。今天，你可以當那個人。

slides.body_en: In 2015, every country agreed on 17 Global Goals for 2030. Goal 10 is Reduced Inequalities — no one should be left behind because of where they are from, what they look like, or what they have.
slides.body_zh: 2015 年，全世界所有國家訂下 17 項全球目標，要在 2030 年前達成。第 10 項是「減少不平等」——不該有人因為出身、長相或擁有的多寡而被丟下。

slides.body_en: Equality means everyone gets the same thing. Equity means everyone gets what they need, so everyone can reach the same goal.
slides.body_zh: 平等（equality），是每個人拿到一樣的東西。公平（equity），是每個人拿到自己需要的東西，讓大家都能到達同一個目標。

slides.q_en: Two students need to see over a wall. One is tall, one is short. What is FAIR?
slides.q_zh: 兩個學生要看過一道牆，一高一矮。怎樣才叫「公平」？

options.en: Give both the same size box
options.zh: 兩個人給一樣高的箱子

options.en: Give the shorter one a taller box
options.zh: 矮的那個給比較高的箱子

slides.explain_en: Equality gives everyone the same. Equity gives everyone what they need to reach the same view.
slides.explain_zh: 平等是「給一樣的」；公平是「給他所需要的」，讓大家都看得到一樣的風景。

slides.q_en: Our school gives every student new shoes — all size 22. Is that fair?
slides.q_zh: 學校送每個學生一雙新鞋——全部都是 22 號。這樣公平嗎？

options.zh: 不公平，每個人的腳大小不同

slides.explain_en: Equal, but not fair! Equity means everyone gets shoes that fit.
slides.explain_zh: 平等，但不公平！公平是每個人都拿到合腳的鞋。

slides.head_en: Same for All, or What You Need?

items.en: Everyone gets one pencil
items.zh: 每個人一支鉛筆

items.en: Glasses for a student who can't see the board
items.zh: 給看不清黑板的同學一副眼鏡

items.en: Every class gets 30 minutes in the gym
items.zh: 每班都有 30 分鐘體育館時間

items.en: A ramp next to the stairs
items.zh: 樓梯旁邊加一條斜坡

items.en: The same test for everyone
items.zh: 每個人考一樣的考卷

items.en: Extra time for a student with a broken arm
items.zh: 手骨折的同學考試多一點時間

items.en: Everyone gets the same school lunch
items.zh: 每個人吃一樣的營養午餐

items.en: Subtitles for people who cannot hear
items.zh: 給聽不到的人看字幕

slides.note_en: Both can be good! Ask: can everyone reach the goal?
slides.note_zh: 兩種都可能是好的！問問看：每個人都到得了目標嗎？

slides.head_zh: 一樣的權利，公平的幫助
slides.body_en: Your school has taught you about children's rights: every child has the right to learn, to play and to be safe. Some children need a little extra help to enjoy those rights. That is not special treatment — that is fair.
slides.body_zh: 你們學校教過兒童權利公約：每個孩子都有學習、遊戲、受保護的權利。有些孩子需要多一點幫助，才能真正享有這些權利。這不是特別待遇，這就是公平。

slides.head_zh: 每 6 個人就有 1 人感受過被歧視
slides.body_en: Because of age, gender, skin color, disability, language, or where they come from.
slides.body_zh: 原因可能是年齡、性別、膚色、身心障礙、語言，或來自哪裡。
slides.ask_en: Which of those could happen at a school?
slides.ask_zh: 這些原因裡，哪幾個可能發生在學校裡？

slides.q_en: Which of these is the BEST way to include a new classmate?
slides.q_zh: 下列哪一個是接納新同學最好的方法？

options.en: Tell them they can join if they want
options.zh: 跟他說他想加入的話可以來

options.en: Say their name and ask them to sit with you
options.zh: 叫出他的名字，請他坐你旁邊

options.en: Wait for them to ask you first
Tell the teacher to assign them a friend
options.zh: 請老師指派一個朋友給他

slides.explain_en: Using someone's name is the fastest way to make them feel real to you. An invitation beats permission.
slides.explain_zh: 叫出名字是讓對方覺得被看見最快的方法。「主動邀請」勝過「允許加入」。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: Treating everyone exactly the same is always fair.
items.zh: 對每個人一模一樣，就一定公平。
items.note_en: People start from different places — fair means giving what is needed.
items.note_zh: 每個人的起點不同，公平是給他需要的。

items.en: Glasses give a student an unfair advantage.
items.zh: 戴眼鏡讓同學佔了便宜。
items.note_en: Glasses don't help you win — they help you see like everyone else.
items.note_zh: 眼鏡不是讓你贏，是讓你跟大家一樣看得見。

items.en: Every child has the right to learn and to play.
items.zh: 每個孩子都有學習和遊戲的權利。
items.note_en: It is in the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child.
items.note_zh: 這寫在聯合國《兒童權利公約》裡。

items.en: Leaving someone out can hurt as much as saying something mean.
items.zh: 把人排除在外，可能跟說難聽話一樣傷人。
items.note_en: Being ignored is one of the most common forms of bullying.
items.note_zh: 被忽略是最常見的霸凌形式之一。

slides.head_zh: 一隻獅子，需要每一個人
slides.body_en: In 2024, Raoming's lion dance team won first place in the four-lion event at the County Magistrate's Cup. The head, the tail and the drummer each do a different job — and the team wins only when every member gets what they need to do their part.
slides.body_zh: 2024 年，饒明舞獅隊在縣長盃拿下四獅比賽第一名。獅頭、獅尾、鼓手各做不同的事——每個隊員都拿到他需要的，才能把自己那一份做好，整隊才會贏。

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many countries in English as you can. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多國家名越好，我來數！
slides.target_zh: 要打破的班級紀錄：15 個

slides.prompt_en: Think of something at school that is the same for everyone. Is it fair for everyone, too?
slides.prompt_zh: 想一件在學校「每個人都一樣」的事。它對每個人也都公平嗎？
slides.sentence_en: At school, ______ is the same for everyone. To make it fair, we could ______.
slides.sentence_zh: 在學校，______ 每個人都一樣。要讓它更公平，我們可以 ______。
slides.time_en: 60 seconds — then 3 pairs share with the class.
slides.time_zh: 60 秒，然後請 3 組跟全班分享。

slides.sub_en: Vote with your hands — 1, 2, 3, or 4 fingers.

items.en: Learn and use people's names
items.zh: 記住並叫出別人的名字

items.en: Invite someone into your group
items.zh: 邀請別人加入你的小組

items.en: Speak up when you hear a mean joke
items.zh: 聽到傷人的玩笑時出聲

items.en: Ask someone about their family's hometown
items.zh: 問問對方家人的家鄉

slides.reveal_en: All four work. #3 is the hardest and the most powerful — it changes what the whole room thinks is okay.
slides.reveal_zh: 四個都有效。第 3 個最難也最有力量——它會改變整個班認為「可以接受」的界線。

items.en: Equal means the same.
items.zh: 平等，是一樣。

items.en: Fair means what you need.
items.zh: 公平，是給需要的。

items.en: Everyone belongs here.
items.zh: 每個人都屬於這裡。

items.en: Come sit with us.
items.zh: 過來跟我們一起坐。

items.en: Be the change.
items.zh: 成為那個改變。

slides.note_en: Watch — then tell me one word you remember.
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我你記得的一個英文單字。

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do This Week
slides.head_zh: 這週你可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Notice who needs a little help — and offer it.
items.zh: 留意誰需要一點幫忙——然後主動幫他。

items.en: Invite one person into something you're doing.
items.zh: 邀請一個人加入你正在做的事。

items.en: If a joke hurts someone, don't laugh.
items.zh: 如果一個玩笑傷到人，就不要跟著笑。

slides.q_en: About how many languages are spoken in Taiwan?
slides.q_zh: 台灣大約有多少種語言在使用？
slides.explain_en: Mandarin, Taiwanese, Hakka and 16+ indigenous languages. Difference is normal here.
slides.explain_zh: 華語、台語、客語，加上 16 種以上的原住民族語。「不一樣」在這裡本來就是常態。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Raoming Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — just write your comment for Teacher Dom.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到饒明國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，直接留言跟 Teacher Dom 互動。

slides.big_en:
Equal is the same.
Fair is what you need.
slides.big_zh: 平等是一樣，公平是給需要的。
